Independent exact refinement and orbit reproduction
correctness.rationale: Intersecting differently named lines through singleton colours makes their unique intersection a singleton in the next round. With C_0, C_g, and successive symbol lines this iterates (tg,0) to ((t+1)g,0), and then all of H² is distinguished. For the proposed partition, each line whose defining value is in H contains h singleton cells and n−h cells in its matching part. Each line defined by a value outside H contains one cell for each H-value in each of the other two line types; the two sets are disjoint (two values in H force the third in H), leaving n−2h cells in Z. This gives equitability for every named relation; past the singleton stage, relation counts against H² read the partial row, column and sum profile. The sizes and census follow, with Z empty exactly for k≤2. Any automorphism of the named relations has coordinate maps α,β with α(x)+β(y)=γ(x+y); subtracting the two translations gives a common group automorphism. Fixing the marks leaves units t with t≡1 mod h. For k≥3 the row-part witnesses (0,1),(0,2) cannot be joined by such a unit; for k=2,h≥3 use (0,1),(0,3). For (n,h)=(4,2), multiplication by 3 swaps the two elements of every nonsingleton part; k=1 is discrete. Independent exact checks for all 231 cases 2≤n≤22, 1≤g<n matched the whole partition and the orbit criterion, including 150 orbit-exact cases. Exhaustive permutation triples for n≤6 also agreed with the affine formula. Replay: python3 /workspace/branches/1ac146ad-a57e-4d05-885e-d46193229a72/independent_record3_check.py.
residual_risks: Finite checks do not prove arbitrary-order stabilizer or refinement claims; those are proved separately by the arguments above.

value.rationale: The theorem gives the entire local counting invariant for a natural marked group table, not just success or failure on particular orders. The orbit comparison exposes an infinite family where counts miss actual symmetry and identifies the sole nongenerator exception, with explicit same-colour different-orbit witnesses for both remaining index regimes. Those are useful distinctions when using refinement to approximate stabilizer orbits.
